title: Rook Roller
description: Two rooks form a ladder. Cut off one rank, then deliver mate on the next.

title: Queen Hunt
description: Bring the queen close to confine the king, then your king does the rest.

title: Rook Squeeze
description: Take the opposition with your king, then drop the rook for checkmate.

title: Cornered
description: Drive the king to the edge. The queen needs the king's support to finish.

title: Edge of the Board
description: The rook and king must coordinate precisely to net the king in two.

title: Trapped in the Corner
description: The king sits in the corner. Find the waiting move, then the rook strikes.
